explanation: The HypoMap atlas section now says how the pinned archive is produced: pnpm run build:hypomap (scripts/hypomap/build_release.py) verifies the pinned inputs, runs the exporter, packages the archive and compares both hashes with the pins; fetch:hypomap installs it from the release asset or a local archive path. The new tag changes the rendered edge rule payloads (re-rendered with edge:apply --write-payloads, no remote request). The release asset is still unpublished.
